model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for different model variants. The x-axis represents the number of completions (k), displayed on a logarithmic base-2 scale ranging from 2⁰ (1) to 2⁸ (256), with tick marks at each power of 2. The y-axis represents coverage on a linear scale, ranging from approximately 0.3 to 0.9, with tick marks at 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. Four lines are shown. The dark blue line with circular markers represents "Llama-3B," starting at approximately 0.42 at k=1 and rising steadily to approximately 0.88 at k=256. The green line with triangular markers represents "Llama-3B + FT," starting at approximately 0.45 at k=1 and increasing to approximately 0.90 at k=256, remaining slightly above the Llama-3B line throughout. The light blue line with no distinct markers (or very small markers) represents "Llama-1B," starting at approximately 0.35 at k=1 and rising to approximately 0.82 at k=256. The light green line with square markers represents "Llama-1B + FT," starting at approximately 0.38 at k=1 and increasing to approximately 0.87 at k=256. All four lines exhibit a monotonically increasing trend that shows a steeper rise at lower values of k and a more gradual increase at higher values, with the 3B model variants consistently positioned above their 1B counterparts, and the fine-tuned (+FT) variants positioned above their non-fine-tuned counterparts.
